title: Regional Coordinator – West
description:
Job Features
   

  

**Overview**
 INTAS Foundation, CSR arm of Intas Pharmaceuticals Ltd., is committed to drive meaningful corporate social responsibility initiatives aimed at uplifting underserved communities across India. Key initiatives such as Apna Ghar, Blood for Life, Patient Assistance Programs, and Emerging Initiatives, impacted over 6\.9 million lives across thirty\-one (31\) States and Union territories. The CSR projects are operational through resolute regional and state teams working cohesively to design, implement, and scale up activities to deliver tangible outcomes. As part of its continued efforts, Foundation is looking to onboard seasoned professional to lead the CSR operations in the region. Seeking a compassionate and driven professional to lead our CSR project implementation efforts in Western India including key locations like Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, Pune, Nagpur, Mumbai and Raipur. This role involves managing ongoing interventions while expanding their reach to new geographies. Candidate will be responsible for program execution, stakeholder engagement, team management, and ensuring that initiatives such as Apna Ghar project runs seamlessly and sustainably.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage on\-ground implementation of CSR projects in alignment with organizational goals and key deliverables.
* Contribute to project planning, budgeting, and defining impact indicators as per Theory of Chage, OECD and SDG framework and ensure outcomes are measured through impact assessment and reporting.
* Network and coordinate with key stakeholders such as government authorities, hospitals, doctors, civil society and local leaders to ensure seamless process flow.
* Ensure hygienic, safe and secure environment for cancer patients and caregivers at Transit Homes where free accommodation, meals, sanitation, and counselling support provisioned.
* Monitor inventory and supply chain to ensure operational readiness of estate and its upkeep and coordinate for timely delivery of project outputs.
* Foster core values and a culture of empathetic and sensitive work environment while delivering project results through various third\-party agencies.
* Recruit, retain and manage talent through town halls, Focus Group Discussions (FGD) and encouraging teams to participate through paper presentations and knowledge exchange with peers across the board.
* Act as the primary contact (SOPC) for all regional matters related to CSR projects and streamline communication between project teams, hospital partners, beneficiaries and central CSR teams.
* Familiarise with Project MIS and dashboard, prepare and present Regional MIS and activity progress, and ensure that the regional impact is captured well in the project quarterly reports, documentation and social media platforms.
* Ensure adherence and compliance with internal policies, audit requirements, and CSR regulations in project execution and timely delivery of project outputs.


**Required Skills And Knowledge**
* Handson experience with CSR Project management \& reporting.
* Demonstrated skills in handling large multi\-state healthcare project.
* Experience in handling project cashflows and settlements.
* Proficiency in application and deployment of digital technologies and tools.
* Ability to recruit, retain and manage remote teams (25–30 members).
* Strong written and spoken communication skills.
* Proven leadership, team \& stakeholder management skills.
* Sectoral knowledge (Healthcare, NCDs and Blood disorders).
* Attention to detail, especially in documentation, reporting, and compliance.


 Qualification
   

  

 Master’s in Social Work, Public Health, Hospital Administration, or a related field.
   

  

**Experience**
 10\+ years in social sector project implementation, preferably in healthcare or patient welfare
   

  

 Salary and Benefits
   

  

 Based on candidate’s experience/qualifications along with benefits include group life insurance, accidental insurance, and reimbursement of travel, medical insurance and leaves as per policy. The position requires 40% travel within and outside the state.

description:
**Location:**

**Industry:**

 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Factory Automation and Smart Manufacturing Manager to lead automation strategy, deployment and operational support within a high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing facility.
 



 The role will own plant automation, automated material handling, ASRS, AGV/AMR, robotics, equipment connectivity and Industry 4\.0 initiatives. The position requires strong engineering leadership and hands\-on experience implementing integrated automation solutions in semiconductor, electronics or advanced manufacturing operations.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and execute the site\-wide factory automation and smart\-manufacturing strategy.
* Lead automation projects from requirement definition and design through commissioning and production acceptance.
* Manage automatic material\-handling systems, ASRS, AGVs, AMRs, robots and cobots.
* Implement automated solutions for material movement, storage, handling, inspection and traceability.
* Establish automation requirements, technical specifications, budgets, schedules and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate equipment, controls, software, facilities, manufacturing and IT integration.
* Lead installation, commissioning, validation and production release of automation systems.
* Integrate automation systems with MES, ERP, warehouse\-management and factory\-data platforms.
* Improve factory productivity, equipment utilization, labour efficiency, quality and cycle time.
* Monitor automation availability, alarms, bottlenecks, downtime and system performance.
* Develop preventive, predictive and condition\-based maintenance strategies for automation assets.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for chronic automation and material\-flow issues.
* Establish safety controls, risk assessments and compliance for robotics and automated equipment.
* Manage automation suppliers, system integrators, equipment vendors and service partners.
* Drive machine vision, industrial IoT, edge\-data and AI\-enabled manufacturing initiatives.
* Develop common automation standards, architecture, interfaces and Best Known Methods.
* Build and lead a multidisciplinary team of automation, controls, robotics and systems engineers.
* Present project performance, operational risks, investment requirements and improvement roadmaps to leadership.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor s or Master s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Automation, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 12 18 years of experience in factory automation, smart manufacturing, industrial controls or automated material handling.
* At least 5 years of experience leading automation teams or large\-scale automation programs.
* Experience in semiconductor, electronics, automotive, battery, pharmaceutical or other high\-volume automated manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience deploying AGV/AMR, ASRS, robotics or integrated material\-handling solutions.
* Strong knowledge of PLC, SCADA, HMI, servo, motion\-control and industrial communication systems.
* Experience integrating automation equipment with MES, ERP or warehouse\-management systems.

title: Senior Manager – Semiconductor Test Manufacturing
description:
Senior Manager Semiconductor Test Manufacturing
 



  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Onsite
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience Range:** 
 18\- 25 Years
 



  





**Industry:** 
 Semiconductor Manufacturing / ATMP / OSAT / Memory Products
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior Manager Semiconductor Test Manufacturing to lead high\-volume semiconductor test operations at an advanced assembly, testing, marking and packaging facility. The position will be responsible for manufacturing performance, production readiness, capacity, yield, quality, cost and cycle time across the test organization.
 



 The role requires extensive semiconductor manufacturing leadership experience, strong knowledge of ATE\-based production testing and the ability to build disciplined, data\-driven operations in a 24 7 manufacturing environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead high\-volume semiconductor test manufacturing operations across assigned production areas.
* Own manufacturing performance for safety, quality, yield, output, cost, cycle time and delivery.
* Develop and execute test\-manufacturing strategies aligned with production and business plans.
* Establish production readiness for new and existing DRAM, NAND, memory\-module or semiconductor products.
* Manage production capacity, equipment utilization, staffing, shift coverage and product\-mix requirements.
* Partner with test engineering, equipment engineering, process engineering and product engineering teams.
* Monitor test yield, retest rates, equipment downtime, throughput and operational efficiency.
* Drive structured problem\-solving for production excursions, yield losses and equipment\-related constraints.
* Implement manufacturing controls, operating procedures and escalation mechanisms.
* Support new\-product introduction and transfer of products from engineering into volume manufacturing.
* Drive cycle\-time reduction, cost improvement, productivity and manufacturing excellence initiatives.
* Maintain compliance with internal quality systems, customer requirements and applicable industry standards.
* Establish performance dashboards and use production data to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Build manufacturing capability through recruitment, training, mentoring and succession planning.
* Lead supervisors, managers, engineers and production teams in a 24 7 manufacturing environment.
* Coordinate with planning, materials, quality and supply\-chain teams to meet output and delivery commitments.
* Promote Lean Manufacturing, TPM, automation and AI\-enabled decision\-making across operations.
* Present manufacturing performance, risks and recovery plans to senior leadership.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline.
* Master s degree in Engineering, Operations or Business Management is preferred.
* 18 25 years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, assembly and test, OSAT, ATMP or a related high\-volume electronics environment.
* Minimum 8 10 years of experience leading manufacturing teams, managers or large production organizations.
* Demonstrated experience in semiconductor test manufacturing or backend semiconductor operations.
* Proven responsibility for production output, yield, equipment utilization, quality, cost and cycle time.
* Experience managing 24 7 manufacturing operations and multi\-shift teams.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive After\-Sales Technical Manager to lead technical support and service activities in the Indian market.

 • Good ability to work with HQ and cross\-functional teams, and effectively communicate technical issues and solutions.

 • Willingness to travel within India when required.

 HAIR RAP BY YOYO is a trendsetting salon brand known for imaginative, high\-standard hair services and a distinctive, holistic approach to hairdressing. Founded in 2022 in India after years of international experience, the salon embodies the creative journey of YoYo, a respected name in the hair industry who trained with leading academies and worked with global brands.  Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Quality and Reliability Manager to lead product\-quality, package\-reliability and qualification activities for memory products in a high\-volume semiconductor assembly and test environment.
 



 The role will own reliability strategy, qualification execution, product\-health monitoring, failure analysis and corrective\-action closure for DRAM, NAND and related memory products. The position requires strong semiconductor product\-quality knowledge and experience working across packaging, assembly, test, product engineering, manufacturing and customer\-quality functions.

* Lead quality and reliability engineering for semiconductor memory products and package technologies.
* Develop product\- and package\-qualification strategies aligned with JEDEC and customer requirements.
* Define reliability test plans, qualification matrices, sample sizes, acceptance criteria and release requirements.
* Manage reliability testing, including HTOL, HAST/uHAST, temperature cycling, MSL and high\-temperature storage.
* Review qualification results and approve products, packages, materials and process changes for manufacturing release.
* Monitor product\-health, reliability, yield, defect and quality indicators during high\-volume manufacturing.

* Prepare qualification reports, reliability summaries, risk assessments and customer\-facing technical documentation.
* Support customer audits, quality reviews and technical discussions related to product and package reliability.
* Build and develop the quality and reliability engineering team.
* Ensure laboratory methods, equipment and records comply with internal and industry requirements.

**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You hold many threads at once without dropping any of them
* You follow up firmly and politely — you don't let things go quiet

* A high\-trust, high\-visibility seat next to leadership

* Room to grow into broader operations responsibility over time

title: Associate Project Manager - Structural
description:
**Responsibilities**
 Walter P Moore India has an immediate opening for an
 **Associate Project Manager** 
 to join their dynamic Structural Engineering team in the Pune office.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess extensive knowledge and experience in the analysis, design, and delivery of structures, utilizing the latest tools and technologies. The sectors served may include Residential and Commercial office buildings, healthcare facilities, airports, and sports venues.
   

  

 An Associate Project Manager will assist the Project Manager / Team Leader’s direction by assisting with technical supervision, staff development, and business development. Here are some key responsibilities for such a position:
   

  

* Project Planning and Management:
* Assist the Project Manager in preparing detailed project plans to meet client/project requirements and deadlines.
* Coordinate with Project Manager to manage the overall project lifecycle from inception through completion, including scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation.
* Ensure compliance with both local and international building codes and regulations.
* Technical Leadership:
* Provide technical guidance to other designers and engineers on the analysis, design, and delivery of structural engineering projects.
* Collaborate with architects, contractors, and other engineering consultants to develop engineering solutions.
* Utilize advanced engineering tools and techniques to optimize project outcomes.
* Develop/implement/follow a robust QA/QC process to review engineering deliverables and initiate appropriate corrective actions when necessary.
* As and when required as per client requirements conduct regular site visits in India during the construction phase of the project. Prepare site observation reports and share with client and contractor
* Client Interaction and Communication:
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, architects, and other stakeholders, ensuring clear and effective communication.
* Understand and address client needs and expectations and provide regular updates on project progress.
* Negotiate with clients and contractors to resolve issues and ensure project delivery within agreed parameters.
* Whenever required participate in business development and client presentations.
* Professional Development and Innovation:
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in structural engineering and project management methodologies.
* Encourage continuous learning and development within the team through workshops, courses, and professional certifications.
* Explore innovative solutions and technologies that can improve efficiency and outcomes of structural engineering projects.


 Our clients include architects, developers, institutional entities, and contractors. The successful candidate must also demonstrate a strong customer service orientation, underpinned by a proactive “can\-do” attitude.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* A minimum of eight years of core experience in structural engineering.
* A Master's degree in Structural Engineering is required.
* Candidates with a PhD in Structural Engineering with the required experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with experience in Structural steel, RCC and PT design shall be given preference.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, with experience leading teams of engineers and modelers.
* Proactive and well\-organized, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* A strong orientation towards client service.


 Walter P Moore is an equal employment opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (including offering competitive compensation and benefits packages) to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Overview**
 Walter P Moore is an international company of engineers, architects, innovators, and creative people who solve some of the world’s most complex structural and infrastructure challenges. Providing structural, diagnostics, civil, traffic, parking, transportation, enclosure, WPM technology and construction engineering services, we design solutions that are cost\- and resource\-efficient, forward\-thinking, and help support and shape communities worldwide. Founded in 1931 and headquartered in Houston, Texas, our 1000\+ professionals work across 26 U.S. offices and 8 international locations.

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity
* Posted 17 hours ago


 Website
 **Trading Technologies**
 Multi\-asset platform for capital markets
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.


 Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services.  This investment supports Trading Technologies’ continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long\-term growth for customers and partners worldwide.

* Lead engineering activities for the Reactor Island, including NSSS and safety\-related systems.

* Monitor engineering progress and identify potential bottlenecks affecting procurement, licensing, construction, or commissioning.
* Coordinate design reviews and technical assessments across reactor island disciplines.
* Ensure alignment between reactor technology supplier deliverables and project execution requirements.


**Nuclear Systems Engineering \& Design Integration**
* Manage engineering integration for:
+ Reactor Core Systems
+ Primary Heat Transport System
+ Steam Generators
+ Pressurizers
+ Reactor Coolant Systems
+ Emergency Core Cooling Systems
+ Safety Injection Systems
+ Radioactive Waste Systems
+ Containment Systems
+ Fuel Handling Systems
+ Nuclear HVAC and Ventilation Systems
+ Radiation Monitoring Systems

* Ensure consistency of design basis across all reactor island systems.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces among civil, mechanical, electrical, I\&C, and safety engineering teams.
* Lead technical resolution of design conflicts and interface issues.


**Design Authority \& Configuration Management Support**
* Support establishment and implementation of Design Authority processes under guidance of Head – Nuclear Engineering.
* Review design changes and modifications affecting nuclear safety, reliability, operability, and constructability.
* Ensure all engineering changes are assessed through appropriate configuration management processes.
* Maintain design basis documentation and engineering records.


**Technical Specification \& Procurement Support**
* Support development and review technical specifications for major reactor island equipment and packages.
* Participate in bid evaluations and technical clarification meetings.
* Review vendor engineering documents and manufacturing drawings.
* Support long\-lead equipment identification and procurement planning.
* Assist QA/QC teams in technical inspections and supplier assessments.


**Regulatory \& Licensing Support**
* Support preparation of engineering documentation required for:
+ Site Approval
+ Construction Consent
+ Regulatory Design Reviews
+ Commissioning Clearances
+ Operational Licensing

* Coordinate technical responses to regulatory observations from AERB and other authorities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable:
+ AERB Codes and Guides
+ IAEA Standards
+ ASME Nuclear Codes
+ RCC\-M
+ IEC Standards
+ International Nuclear Best Practices

* Participate in regulator interactions and technical presentations


**Construction \& Commissioning Engineering Support**
* Resolve site engineering queries and non\-conformances.
* Support construction sequencing and constructability reviews.
* Lead technical evaluation of field change requests.
* Support commissioning procedure reviews and pre\-operational testing activities.
* Ensure engineering closure of punch points and commissioning observations.


**Reactor Technology \& Capability Development**
* Develop in\-house expertise in selected reactor technologies such as:
+ PHWR
+ VVER
+ AP1000
+ EPR
+ SMR technologies

* Capture and institutionalize lessons learned from global and Indian nuclear projects.
* Mentor junior engineers and develop engineering competency within the organization.
* Support implementation of digital engineering tools, engineering databases, and knowledge management systems.
* 15\+ years in nuclear power, conventional power, or other highly regulated process industries.
* Minimum 8–10 years of direct experience in reactor island engineering, systems engineering, design review, commissioning, or project engineering.
* Exposure to PHWR and/or international LWR technologies.
* Experience working with AERB, NPCIL, reactor vendors, or Owner's Engineers would be highly preferred


**Qualifications**
* 15\+ years in nuclear power, conventional power, or other highly regulated process industries.

* Exposure to PHWR and/or international LWR technologies.
* Experience working with AERB, NPCIL, reactor vendors, or Owner's Engineers would be highly preferred

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer - Product Development
description:
Immediate Hiring \| Joining Date: 1st October 2026 (or Earlier Preferred)
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Company: iNSPIRE Design
 



  





  





 Please Read Before Applying
 



 We are looking for a Lead Mechanical Engineer who can join on or before 1st September 2026\.
 



 If you are serving a notice period that extends beyond this date, please apply only if your current employer is willing to provide an early release.
 



 This is an immediate requirement, and applications from candidates who can join within the required timeline will be given preference.
 



  





  





 About iNSPIRE Design
 



 iNSPIRE Design is a product development and engineering company based in Ahmedabad. We work with startups, established companies, research institutions, and healthcare professionals to develop new products from early\-stage concepts through functional prototypes and manufacturing readiness.
 



 Our projects primarily involve medical devices, electromechanical products, test fixtures, consumer products, automation systems, and custom engineering solutions. The work is highly varied and requires strong first\-principles engineering, practical problem\-solving, rapid prototyping, and close coordination with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking for a senior, hands\-on mechanical engineer who can take technical ownership of complex product development projects.
 



 This is not a role limited to CAD modelling or preparing drawings. The selected candidate will be expected to understand client requirements, develop product architectures, make engineering decisions, guide junior engineers and designers, resolve prototype failures, and lead projects through design, testing, iteration, and manufacturing handover.
 



 The person should be capable of operating independently and gradually taking ownership of the day\-to\-
 



 day engineering function within the company.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





  





 Product Development and Engineering
 


* Lead mechanical product development projects from initial requirements through functional prototype and manufacturing readiness.
* Convert incomplete or evolving client requirements into clear engineering specifications and development plans.
* Develop product architecture, mechanisms, assemblies, enclosures, structural components, and electromechanical integration concepts.
* Perform engineering calculations related to loads, stresses, fits, tolerances, motion, thermal behaviour, material selection, and manufacturing feasibility.
* Identify technical risks early and develop practical methods to test and reduce those risks.
* Review existing designs critically and recommend improvements based on performance, reliability, cost, usability, and manufacturability.
* Troubleshoot prototype failures and lead structured root\-cause analysis and corrective action.



  





  





 Design and Documentation
 


* Create and review detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Apply appropriate GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, fits, clearances, fastener selection, and assembly considerations.
* Maintain proper revision control, design records, BOMs, technical specifications, and project documentation.
* Ensure designs are suitable for prototyping as well as eventual production.
* Conduct design reviews and approve engineering outputs before release.



  





  





 Prototyping and Testing
 


* Plan and supervise the fabrication and assembly of proof\-of\-concept and functional prototypes.
* Select suitable prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, laser cutting, casting, and off\-the\-shelf component integration.
* Develop test plans, fixtures, acceptance criteria, and validation methods.
* Personally participate in prototype assembly, testing, debugging, and design iteration where required.
* Make sound engineering decisions even when complete data or ideal resources are unavailable.



  





  





 Manufacturing and Vendor Coordination
 


* Work directly with machine shops, fabricators, moulders, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Review vendor quotations, manufacturing processes, tolerances, material specifications, and technical capabilities.
* Resolve manufacturing and assembly issues without compromising critical product requirements.
* Support design for manufacturing, design for assembly, cost reduction, and production handover activities.
* Evaluate whether components should be custom\-developed, modified, or sourced as standard parts.



  





  





 Technical Leadership
 


* Guide and review the work of mechanical engineers, industrial designers, interns, and prototyping staff.
* Break larger projects into clearly defined engineering tasks and assign them effectively.
* Establish practical design standards, review processes, calculation practices, and documentation systems.
* Coach junior team members while maintaining accountability for timelines and quality.
* Raise the overall technical capability and engineering discipline of the organisation.
* Take responsibility for technical decisions rather than depending on constant direction from the founder.



  





  





 Project and Client Ownership
 


* Participate in client discussions to understand technical requirements, constraints, and priorities.
* Explain engineering decisions, risks, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Prepare realistic project plans, resource estimates, development timelines, and technical deliverables.
* Track engineering progress and proactively address delays, dependencies, and technical blockers.
* Represent the company confidently during technical reviews, vendor discussions, and client meetings.
* Balance engineering quality with commercial realities, project budgets, and delivery commitments.



  





  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related discipline.
* Approximately 7–12 years of relevant experience in mechanical product development, machine design, medical devices, electromechanical products, automation, or a similar field.
* Strong hands\-on experience taking physical products from concept through prototyping and manufacturing.
* Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks or a comparable parametric CAD platform.
* Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, tolerances, GD\&T, and assembly methods.
* Demonstrated ability to perform engineering calculations and validate designs through testing.
* Experience working directly with vendors and resolving real\-world manufacturing problems.
* Experience leading projects or mentoring junior engineers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-moving, project\-driven environment.



  





  





 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience developing medical devices or healthcare\-related products.
* Experience with electromechanical systems involving motors, sensors, actuators, PCBs, wiring, batteries, heating systems, fluid systems, or embedded electronics.
* Familiarity with risk management, verification, validation, and regulated product development.
* Working knowledge of FEA, thermal analysis, tolerance analysis, and design optimisation.
* Experience with injection moulding, silicone moulding, sheet metal, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, project plans, cost estimates, and client presentations.
* Exposure to quality systems, ISO 13485, design controls, or medical device documentation would be an advantage.



  





  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 The right candidate will be:
 


* A strong engineer first and a manager second.
* Comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for the outcome.
* Highly practical and capable of turning concepts into working physical products.
* Willing to question assumptions and challenge technically weak approaches.
* Systematic when investigating failures and resolving engineering problems.
* Capable of balancing ideal engineering solutions with cost, timelines, available resources, and manufacturability.
* Comfortable working across multiple projects and industries.
* Able to communicate directly with clients and defend engineering decisions.
* Interested in building an engineering team and improving how product development is executed across the company.



  





  





 What This Role Is Not
 



 This is not a role for someone whose experience is limited to:
 


* Creating CAD models based on instructions provided by others.
* Managing teams without remaining technically hands\-on.
* Working only on one narrow component or process within a large organisation.
* Preparing presentations and reports without building and testing physical products.
* Waiting for complete requirements before beginning engineering work.



  





  





 Why Join iNSPIRE Design
 


* Work on diverse and technically challenging product development projects.
* Take meaningful ownership of products rather than working on isolated components.
* Work directly with founders, clients, researchers, doctors, startups, and manufacturing partners.
* Build prototypes and see designs progress from initial concepts to real physical products.
* Play a central role in developing the company’s engineering function.
* Opportunity to grow into broader engineering and technical leadership responsibilities as the organisation expands.



  





  





 Application Requirements
 



 Candidates should submit:
 


* An updated resume.
* A brief portfolio or examples of products, mechanisms, machines, or assemblies they have personally developed.
* A clear description of their individual contribution to each project.
* Details of one significant prototype or product failure they diagnosed and resolved.
* Current location, notice period, and availability for an on\-site role in Ahmedabad.

title: Specification Manager - Luxury Interiors & Projects
description:
**JSB is looking for someone who sells a premium material to architects, designers, developers and discerning homeowners — and wants a better one to sell them.** 




  





**About** 




  





 Founded in Kishangarh in 1993, JSB is one of India's largest importers and processors of natural marble. We buy blocks directly at the quarry across more than 40 countries, process them at our own facility, and hold over 400 colours in live inventory — Statuario, Calacatta, Brazilian quartzite, onyx, travertine and exotic stones.
 



  





 Architects, designers, developers and homeowners travel from across India to our Kishangarh Experience Centre to select their slabs personally.
 



  





 We deal in imported marble only. No Indian marble. No granite.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 We are opening Ahmedabad, and we are looking for the person who will own Gujarat.
 



  





 This is specification work. There is no dealer network to appoint and no monthly order book to service. Your job is to make JSB the material that gets specified — the name reached for when a project calls for something extraordinary underfoot.
 



  





 Your clientele is the full top end of the market:
 



  





 • Architects and design studios
 



 • Interior designers and turnkey interior firms
 



 • Luxury residential and hospitality developers
 



 • Project management consultants on premium projects
 



 • HNI homeowners building or renovating privately
 



  





 You will get JSB specified at design stage, hold the relationship through material selection, and bring your client to Kishangarh to choose their stone with their own eyes.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





 • Build a specification map of Gujarat's top end — studio by studio, developer by developer, principal by principal — starting in Ahmedabad and extending through Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat and Rajkot
 



 • Get JSB specified at design stage on luxury residences, villas and farmhouses, high\-end apartment projects, hospitality, premium retail and flagship corporate interiors
 



 • Work both sides of a project: the design studio that specifies the material, and the developer, PMC or homeowner who signs for it
 



 • Run material presentations, place samples, and establish JSB inside design studio material libraries
 



 • Bring clients to Kishangarh. Marble is chosen with the eye. Your project becomes real when your client is standing in our slab yard, looking at the block.
 



 • Guide clients through selection: colour, veining, book\-matching, finish, and how a slab will read in the space it is going into
 



 • Own the project from selection through to delivery coordination with HQ
 



 • Maintain a disciplined pipeline: project, area in sq ft, stage, decision maker
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 You are most likely doing something close to this today at a luxury interiors or premium surfaces brand — Kohler, TOTO, Duravit, Grohe, Hansgrohe, Roca, Villeroy \& Boch, Artize, Cosentino, Caesarstone, Laminam, Häfele, Hettich, Asian Paints Beautiful Homes, Saint\-Gobain, Greenlam, or a premium lighting or decorative finishes brand.
 



  





 What matters more than the logo on your card:
 



  





 • 6 to 12 years selling a premium or luxury interior product into design studios and high\-end projects, with Ahmedabad and Gujarat as your working territory
 



 • A live relationship map you personally own — architects, interior designers, luxury developers, PMCs and HNI clients
 



 • You have sold a premium material against a cheaper alternative and won on design and value, not on discount
 



 • You can hold your own in a design conversation. You understand that when an architect chooses a material, they are choosing how a room will feel — and you can talk about it that way.
 



 • You can also hold your own in a commercial conversation with a developer or PMC on rate, quantity and delivery
 



 • You are comfortable in premium rooms: design studios, owner\-side site meetings, HNI drawing rooms
 



 • Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English
 



 • Graduate. A B.Arch or interior design background is a genuine advantage. MBA optional.
 



  





**Straight talk before you apply** 




  





 We would rather lose you at the advert than at month three.
 



  





 • There is no regional office or showroom in Ahmedabad. You work from the field, out of design studios and client sites. Telecalling, back office, inventory and processing all sit at Kishangarh HQ.
 



 • There is no dedicated company vehicle. Travel is reimbursed against actuals.
 



 • Clients buy by seeing the slab. A meaningful part of your performance is how many qualified clients you bring to Kishangarh.
 



 • The first 90 days are field\-first. Personal meetings, personally done.
 



 • Compensation is part fixed and part performance. The variable is uncapped and tiered by project value band, so specifying higher\-value stone pays you materially more.
 



  





 If you want a showroom to sit in and a dealer network to service, this is not your role. If you want to build a territory in your own name, for a house that buys its own blocks at the quarry and processes them itself, it is.
 



  





**What we offer** 




  





 • Fixed salary of 5\-6 LPA, based on experience and the strength of your existing network
 



 • Uncapped tiered incentive on project value, paid above threshold
 



 • Travel reimbursed at actuals, plus mobile allowance
 



 • A material with genuine range. Over 400 colours in live inventory, so you are rarely the one saying no.
 



 • Direct access to principal\-level decision making. We own the buying, the inventory and the processing, so you are never waiting on a third party to quote.
 



  





**To apply** 




  





 Email keshav.bangur@jsbstonex.com with the subject line: Specification Manager – Ahmedabad – \[Your Name]
 



  





 Answer these three questions in your email. Applications that do not answer them are not reviewed.
 



  





 1\. Name three architecture, design or developer clients in Ahmedabad you have personally worked with, and the person you deal with at each.
 



 2\. What is the largest single project you have personally specified? Project type and approximate area or value.
 



 3\. Your current fixed CTC and notice period.
 



  





 Applications are reviewed personally. If you are shortlisted, you will hear from us within five working days.

title: Sr. Firmware Engineer / Firmware Lead
description:
**About Oizom** 


 Oizom builds environmental monitoring hardware and software — air quality, noise, vibration, and gas\-sensing products deployed in the field across multiple markets. Our product line spans Polludrone (ambient air quality), Sonicbot (Class 1 noise monitoring), Seismibot (ground vibration), OGS (electrochemical gas sensing), Sensorbox, and AirOwl (our open\-source ESP32\-based air quality monitor). Our R\&D team spans Industrial Design, Design Engineering, Embedded Hardware, and Embedded Firmware.
 



**Role Summary** 


 We're hiring a Senior Firmware Engineer to lead our embedded firmware team. This is a hybrid role: roughly half hands\-on architecture and development across our MCU and embedded\-Linux product lines, and half technical leadership — mentoring junior engineers, setting coding and review standards, and owning firmware delivery across multiple concurrent product programs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

**Technical leadership** 



* Lead and mentor a team of 3–5 junior/mid firmware engineers — code reviews, design reviews, and hands\-on pairing
* Own firmware architecture decisions across product lines and make the build\-vs\-buy, framework, and platform calls
* Set and enforce firmware coding standards, version control practices, and release processes
* Plan and track firmware workstreams against product timelines; report status to the Head of R\&D



**Hands\-on development** 



* Develop and maintain firmware for ESP32/ESP32\-S3\-based products (sensor readout, connectivity, power management)
* Develop and maintain firmware for STM32\-based products (bare\-metal or RTOS, sensor interfacing, real\-time measurement paths)
* Build and maintain Python\-based firmware/application software for Raspberry Pi CM4\-based products (config\-driven sensor drivers, Modbus/serial interfacing, BLE, edge processing)
* Containerize and deploy services using Docker (on\-device services and supporting cloud/data pipelines)
* Implement and debug communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, MQTT, BLE
* Work closely with Embedded Hardware and Design Engineering on bring\-up, debugging, and DFM feedback loops


**Required Skills \& Experience** 
* 6–9 years of professional embedded firmware development experience, including at least 1–2 years in a lead or mentoring capacity
* Strong C/C\+\+ firmware development on
 
**ESP32** 

 (Arduino or ESP\-IDF) and
 
**STM32** 

 (bare\-metal or an RTOS such as FreeRTOS)
* Strong
 
**Python 3** 

 for embedded Linux application/firmware work on
 
**Raspberry Pi CM4** 

 or similar SBCs
* Practical experience with
 
**Docker** 

 — containerizing device\-side services and/or supporting data pipelines
* Solid grasp of embedded communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, and at least one of RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, or MQTT
* Hands\-on experience with wireless/cellular connectivity:
 
**Quectel 4G/LTE modules** 

 (AT command interfacing),
 
**LoRa** 

 ,
 
**WiFi** 

 , and
 
**BLE** 

 stacks
* Comfortable with hardware\-level debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, reading schematics and datasheets
* Git\-based version control and structured code review practices
* Demonstrated ability to lead a small team — planning work, unblocking others, and maintaining code quality without micromanaging


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience with sensor\-heavy or field\-deployed IoT products (environmental, industrial, or similar harsh\-environment hardware)
* Experience with cellular modules (e.g., Telit/Quectel LTE) and connectivity recovery/watchdog design
* Familiarity with a self\-hosted data stack (e.g., MQTT broker, Telegraf/InfluxDB/Grafana) for device telemetry
* Exposure to analog front\-end or electrochemical/gas\-sensing signal chains
* Experience with BLE peripheral/central firmware
* Prior experience in a startup or small\-team R\&D environment where you owned outcomes end\-to\-end

title: Supply Chain Planning Lead – T-FIT
description:
Zotefoams plc is a global leader in advanced cellular materials, trusted by some of the world’s most recognised brands to deliver high‑performance solutions.
   

  

 We design and manufacture lightweight, high‑quality foam products that support innovation across sectors including sports and leisure, aviation, automotive, medical and industrial applications. Alongside our core materials business, we develop and commercialise patented technologies and deliver specialist insulation systems for complex, high‑value environments.
   

  

 This is an exciting time to join Zotefoams. We are growing internationally, investing in our people, technology and capabilities, and seeing increasing demand for our products across global markets. Our work sits at the heart of innovation, helping customers push boundaries in performance, sustainability and design.
   

  

 We offer the chance to be part of a collaborative, forward‑thinking organisation where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your contribution has real impact on a global scale.
   

  

**About the Role\~**
 This is a key role responsible for coordinating demand, supply, inventory and production planning across our internal and external supply chain.
   

  

 You will translate sales forecasts and customer requirements into clear, achievable supply plans, working closely with production, procurement, logistics and commercial teams. You will help improve planning discipline, provide greater visibility of risks and support the business in meeting its customer service, revenue and inventory objectives.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced planning professional who enjoys bringing structure to a growing business, working across multiple functions and using data to support effective decisions.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities\~**
* Supporting the development and delivery of demand, supply and inventory planning processes for the T\-FIT business.
* Coordinating regular demand and supply reviews, ensuring assumptions, constraints, risks and actions are clearly captured.
* Translating sales forecasts and customer requirements into practical supply and production plans.
* Working closely with production sites, procurement, logistics and commercial teams to align supply with demand.
* Maintaining accurate planning data, assumptions and key system inputs.
* Monitoring inventory and product availability, identifying risks relating to customer service, excess stock and working capital.
* Identifying capacity constraints, material risks and planning gaps that could affect monthly supply or revenue.
* Producing clear planning reports and updates covering demand, supply, inventory, service and forecast accuracy.
* Improving data quality, planning discipline and adherence to agreed processes.
* Escalating risks and trade\-offs clearly, supported by practical recommendations.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of planning processes, reporting and ways of working.


**What you'll need\~**
* At least five years’ experience within supply chain planning, demand planning, production planning, manufacturing, logistics or a related role.
* A good understanding of demand, supply, inventory or production planning principles.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data, spreadsheets, enterprise resource planning systems and planning reports.
* The ability to turn commercial forecasts and customer requirements into realistic operational plans.
* Clear communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders across commercial, manufacturing, procurement and logistics teams.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage changing priorities.
* The confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, identify risks and recommend appropriate action.
* This role involves regular communication with stakeholders across the UK, Europe, USA and Asia, therefore strong spoken and written English is essential.


**It would be beneficial if you also have**
* A degree or professional qualification in supply chain, business, engineering or a related subject.
* Experience with sales and operations planning, sales and operations execution, material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning processes.
* Experience working within an international or multi\-site manufacturing business.


**Why Join Us?**
 Zotefoams is growing fast, investing globally and winning in new markets. This is a chance to be part of a business where things are moving, decisions are made quickly, and your work has real impact.
   

  

 You won’t be a small cog here. You’ll have the space to take ownership, contribute ideas and see them through. We back our people to develop, step up and build long term careers, supported by a team that works together and delivers.
   

  

**Our Values**
**Courage** 
 – We challenge, act and push for better.
   

  

**Impact** 
 – We focus on what matters and deliver results.
   

  

**Respect** 
 – We value different perspectives and work as one team.
   

  

 Zotefoams is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Zotefoams is a world leader in cellular material technology. Using a unique manufacturing process with environmentally friendly nitrogen expansion, Zotefoams produces lightweight foams in Croydon, UK and Kentucky, USA for diverse markets worldwide. These markets include sports and leisure, storage and protection, automotive, aviation and space, railway, healthcare, building, marine and the military.

title: Founder's office
description:
**Location:** 

 Ahmedabad (hybrid)
 
**Reports to:** 

 Founders
 
**Type:** 

 Full\-time
 



**About the role** 


 We're looking for someone to sit close to the founders and help make the agency run better. Someone who can look at how we deliver work for clients, spot where time and money leak, and fix it. You'll start on operations and process, move into client\-facing work within 6 months, and be positioned to lead ops for the agency in 2–3 years.
 





 This is a build\-and\-own role. You'll get access to how the business actually runs and be expected to bring structure to it, not just watch.
 



**What you'll actually do** 

**First 6 months \- operations and systems** 



* Map how work currently moves through the agency: brief → proposal → kickoff → delivery → review → renewal. Find where it breaks.
* Build and maintain SOPs for recurring workflows (SEO/AEO retainers, website redesigns, content production, campaign reporting)
* Track project timelines and deliverables across accounts, flag slippage before clients do
* Work with founders on proposal scoping and pricing \- sit in on the conversations, not just format the docs
* Own internal reporting: what's on time, what's at risk, what's profitable
* Sit in on client calls to learn the accounts, the people, and how we sell and service



**6 months onward \- client\-facing** 



* Take direct ownership of select client relationships (starting smaller/lower\-risk accounts, scaling up)
* Run status calls, handle day\-to\-day client communication, manage scope conversations
* Be the point of escalation before it needs to reach a founder



**2–3 years \- ops leadership** 



* Own agency operations end to end: resourcing, delivery quality, tooling, process
* Build and manage a small ops/PM function as the agency scales
* Be a founder\-level thinking partner on how the business is structured and run


**What we need from you** 
* 1–2 years of experience in agency operations, client servicing, or project management \- ideally at a marketing, design, or digital agency
* You understand what "billable," "scope creep," and "retainer" mean in your sleep
* Sharp with tools \- you should already be using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your daily work, not as a novelty but because it makes you faster. We're an AI\-native shop; if you're not already working this way, this isn't the right fit
* Comfortable being in rooms with founders and clients and holding your own
* A working sense of tech and marketing \- you don't need to write code or run ad campaigns yourself, but you should understand what SEO, performance marketing, brand identity, and website work actually involve, enough to spot bad scoping or a missed handoff
* Sharp with spreadsheets, docs, and basic reporting \- you'll be building the systems, not waiting for someone to hand them to you
* Low ego about the work. Early on this role involves a lot of unglamorous process\-building before it becomes client\-facing


**Nice to have, not required** 
* Prior experience at a boutique or small agency (where you wear multiple hats by necessity)
* Exposure to B2B SaaS or D2C client environments
* Some hands\-on experience with SEO/AEO, content, or performance marketing basics


**Why this role** 


 Most ops or associate roles at agencies keep you in a lane. This one doesn't \- you're in the room for strategy, scoping, and delivery from day one, and the path to owning a P\&L\-relevant function is explicit, not vague. If you want to eventually run something rather than support something, this is built for that.

**Description**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**

title: Assistant General Manager, Manufacturing
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
* Technical Leadership \& Process Optimization
* Upstream Strategy: Lead the design, optimization, and troubleshooting of Solid\-Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS) protocols, including difficult sequences and modification chemistry.
* Downstream Scaling: Direct the scaling up of Preparative HPLC and RP\-HPLC purification methods from analytical to pilot/production scale.
* Troubleshooting: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) to resolve complex synthesis failures, poor solubility issues, and challenging impurity profiles.
* Tech Transfer: Oversee the seamless transfer of peptide processes from the R\&D stage to validation and commercial production batches.
* Operations \& Team Management
* Resource Allocation: Manage a team 22 members of engineers/scientists, assigning daily synthesis, purification, and lyophilization tasks.
* Project Timelines: Ensure projects meet strict delivery schedules while optimizing raw material consumption (resins, protected amino acids, solvents).
* Equipment Oversight: Oversee the calibration, maintenance, and qualification of automated synthesizers, Prep\-HPLC systems, and lyophilizers.
* Data Integrity: Review and sign off on chromatograms, analytical data, Master Batch Records (MBRs), and final batch release reports.
* Compliance Lead: Ensure the laboratory strictly adheres to GLP/GMP guidelines, data integrity standards, and safety regulations.
* SOP Authoring: Author, update, and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), deviation reports, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).


**Qualifications**
**Candidate Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: B.Tech / M.Tech in Biotechnology or Chemical Engineering OR M.Sc. / Ph.D. in Organic, Analytical, or Biochemistry.
* Experience: 15 to 18\+ years of core industrial experience in peptide chemistry, with at least 2\+ years in a supervisory or team\-leading role.
* Technical Mastery: Deep, provable expertise spanning both upstream chain\-building (cleavage, coupling) and downstream isolation (salt\-exchange, TFF, freeze\-drying).
* Software Literacy: High proficiency in chromatography data software (e.g., Empower, Chromeleon) and data analysis tools.
* Soft Skills: Strong project management, clear cross\-functional communication, and a proven track record of mentoring junior scientists.

 Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our Project \& Development Services (PDS) team delivers comprehensive project and program management services across diverse industries and geographies.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead corporate interior projects across Gujarat. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities who can manage end\-to\-end project delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Planning \& Execution**
 The Project Manager will oversee all phases of corporate interior projects from initiation through closeout. You will develop comprehensive project plans, establish timelines and milestones, coordinate design development with architects and consultants, and ensure alignment with client objectives and brand standards. Managing project scope, schedule, budget, and quality parameters while anticipating and mitigating risks will be central to your role.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management**
 Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, you will build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders including client representatives, design consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal JLL teams. You will conduct regular progress meetings, provide transparent communication on project status, and manage expectations effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Financial \& Contract Management**
 You will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates and budget forecasts, monitoring project expenditures and cash flows, reviewing and approving contractor invoices and change orders, and ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets. Administering contracts and ensuring compliance with terms and conditions will be essential aspects of this role.
   

  

**Quality \& Compliance**
 Ensuring that all work meets JLL quality standards and client specifications is paramount. You will conduct regular site inspections and quality audits, verify compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and statutory requirements, coordinate testing and commissioning activities, and manage the punch list and defect rectification process.
   

  

**Team Leadership**
 You will lead project teams including consultants, contractors, and JLL staff members. Building collaborative working relationships, providing clear direction and guidance, monitoring team performance, and fostering a culture of excellence and accountability will be key leadership responsibilities.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
 Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management is required. A minimum of 8\-12 years of experience in project management with specific focus on corporate interiors, office fit\-outs, or commercial projects is essential. Proven track record of successfully delivering multiple projects simultaneously in the Gujarat region is highly preferred.
   

  

**Technical Competencies**
 Strong knowledge of interior construction methodologies, materials, and finishes is required. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent software, along with advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) is expected. Thorough understanding of building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards applicable to commercial interiors is necessary. Familiarity with MEP systems coordination and integration within interior spaces is valued.
   

  

**Professional Skills**
 Excellent communication and presentation abilities in English and Hindi (Gujarati is advantageous) are required. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities, along with exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, are essential. Financial acumen with experience in budgeting, cost control, and forecasting is necessary. Client\-focused mindset with commitment to service excellence is fundamental to success in this role.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 PMP or equivalent project management certification demonstrates professional commitment. Experience working with multinational corporations or large\-scale corporate clients is valuable. Knowledge of sustainable building practices and LEED/IGBC certification processes is beneficial. Exposure to design\-build or integrated project delivery methods is advantageous.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Opportunity to work with leading multinational and domestic corporate clients on prestigious interior projects. Collaborative work environment with experienced professionals committed to excellence. Professional development opportunities including training programs and certifications. Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Exposure to diverse project types across various industry sectors.
   

  

**Location**
 Gujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar preferred, with willingness to travel across Gujarat as needed)
   

  

**JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our clients and communities. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.
   

  

 To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter through JLL's career portal or contact your local HR representative for application procedures.
